attBesluta.text: Love the price point for these! Everything slipped together just fine on the dove tails. One board had split along the grain, probably just from moisture changes on the wood. A little wood glue solved it easy. Frames immediately went into a late swarm catch in a 5 frame box, the rest will have to wait for spring as we have some overwintered nucs ordered. The coating is great, didn't have to worry about staining, ready right out of the box. Windows are cool. We will definitely get more of theses.
Happy with purchase, quality product that doesn't cost much
absolutely fantastic and quick response to a minor issue Labour intensive but works great

Pros. Very pretty looking beehive. Joints are accurate and very tightly fitting. Cons. It really should come with a Varroa mesh floor and tray. It should be stated more clearly that it is (unlike most Langstroth beehives) a bottom bee-space as opposed top bee-space hive. It should have the option of buying a hive consisting of one deep box along with two or three medium boxes, instead of two of each.
Very good price. One part was missing, customer care went out of their way to make it right. Keep in mind that vevor does not stock replacement parts, but they will take care of the issue.

These Bee Hives were of OK quality. We had issues with the frame assembly because on the shallow frames, the foundations would not stay in. Contacted VEVOR and they quickly sent a video on how to fix the problem by shaving down a piece on each frame to make them work. The solution did solve the problem however it was VERY time consuming and a big disappointment.... Other than that, the hives seem ok. Our bees have moved in and everything is going well...
Von der Bestellung bis zur Lieferung und Montage der einzelnen Elemente war alles super und in der Montageanleitung klar und deutlich beschrieben. Artikel ist absolut empfehlenswert.
Great product for the price. Easy to assemble and good quality.
Love the price and the "Goober peephole" viewing window. Instructions could have been better because I cracked one.
